author: XFDG
scope: Merged upstream PRs only, in selected AI infrastructure repositories; community and internship contributions are identified separately.

prs.zh: 隔离 Linux hugepage 依赖，修复 macOS Store 构建兼容性；不等同于全部传输后端支持 macOS。
prs.en: Guard Linux-only hugepage dependencies for macOS Store builds; not a claim of macOS support for every transport.

prs.zh: 保留 BatchReplicaClear RPC 的租户身份，避免同名对象跨租户误清理。
prs.en: Preserve tenant identity in BatchReplicaClear RPCs to prevent cross-tenant cleanup of same-named objects.

prs.zh: 使本地 MEMORY 副本优先级不受返回顺序影响，并补充回归用例；最终范围不含 SSD session 支持。
prs.en: Make local MEMORY preference independent of replica order, with regression coverage; the final scope excludes SSD session support.

prs.zh: 未实际入队时返回失败，避免 Offloading 幽灵任务及引用计数泄漏。
prs.en: Report no-op offload enqueue as failure to avoid phantom tasks and reference-count leaks.

prs.zh: 先同步数据再提交元数据，处理同步失败后的孤儿文件清理。
prs.en: Synchronize bucket data before committing metadata and clean up orphan files after sync failure.

prs.zh: RDMA 端口恢复后淘汰失效 Endpoint / QP，使后续请求重建连接。
prs.en: Evict stale endpoints and queue pairs after RDMA port recovery so subsequent requests rebuild connections.

prs.zh: 内存注销后恢复 fork 状态，并修正注销后的元数据生命周期。
prs.en: Restore fork state after memory deregistration and respect memory-region metadata lifetime.

prs.zh: AdaMax 算子、资源变量支持与测试覆盖。
prs.en: AdaMax operators, resource-variable support and tests.

prs.zh: 长跑稳定性、OOM 与 GradientDescent locking 修复。
prs.en: Long-run stability, OOM and GradientDescent locking fixes.

prs.zh: GradientDescent 普通变量与资源变量算子。
prs.en: GradientDescent operators for reference and resource variables.

prs.zh: 调试计时与 shape 同步稳定性。
prs.en: Debug timing and shape synchronization stability.

prs.zh: Logical_Or 标量广播优化及逻辑算子测试。
prs.en: Logical_Or scalar-broadcast optimization and logical-operator tests.

prs.zh: AddV2 热路径优化与性能分析降噪。
prs.en: AddV2 hot-path optimization and profiling-noise reduction.

prs.zh: muDNN GELU、融合链路与真实 shape benchmark。
prs.en: muDNN GELU, fusion fixes and workload-shaped benchmarks.

prs.zh: ResourceApplyAdam 更新与 Session 关闭修复。
prs.en: ResourceApplyAdam updates and session-close stability.

prs.zh: GELU 图融合实现与正确性验证。
prs.en: GELU graph fusion and correctness validation.

prs.zh: Kernel Timing 性能分析工具。
prs.en: Kernel timing instrumentation.

prs.zh: 让 grpcio registered handlers 经过 Serve proxy，保留 passthrough 服务并兼容旧版 API。
prs.en: Route grpcio registered handlers through the Serve proxy, preserving passthrough services and older-API compatibility.

prs.zh: 修复 BF16 rank-major session CPU 测试在已安装包隔离环境中的资源定位，保持无需导入 CUDA driver 的测试约定。
prs.en: Fix resource lookup for BF16 rank-major session CPU tests in isolated installed-package layouts without importing the CUDA driver.

prs.zh: 调整 Qwen3 示例的 lm_head padding 初始化，处理 padding 参与 Argmax 的非法 Token 问题。
prs.en: Adjust lm_head padding initialization in Qwen3 demos to address invalid tokens from padded Argmax candidates.

prs.zh: 修复 Cross-Encoder padding token_type_ids 的填充与区间压缩/重建语义，并补充回归验证。
prs.en: Preserve cross-encoder padding token types through padding, range compression and reconstruction, with regression coverage.

prs.zh: 修复 ZeRO-1/2 与 ZenFlow overlap 路径的 BF16 overflow-check opt-out，同时保留 FP32/FP16 非有限梯度保护。
prs.en: Honor BF16 overflow-check opt-out in ZeRO-1/2 and ZenFlow overlap while retaining FP32/FP16 nonfinite-gradient protection.

verification.author: XFDG
verification.method: GitHub merged search plus individual PR merged/author verification
